games.name: SCORCHED EARTH 🔊
games.desc:
Hardcore Sandbox FPS, featuring advanced destruction, building, and volumetric smoke grenades.

Roblox Premium gives you 15% extra match bonus.

Private servers have everything unlocked & server tools, but stats dont transfer to the main game.

C / X: lower/raise stance
Q & E: lean
M: open squad menu
TAB: scoreboard
B: cycle firemode
V: melee (only for some tools and bayonets)
AIM + SHIFT: steady aim
AIM + SCROLL: zeroing (only on some weapons)
AIM + ALT: switch to irons
T: Squad orders/ping
CTRL / Tilde (~): aim (for laptop users)
C + SCROLL: incremental stances

Beta released on July 12th 2024.
